method: Soft voting: average of the members' softmax probabilities (equal weights)
explanation: Full-data version of E13v: soft vote of E10b (224 bicubic) + E14a (144 nearest) + E14b (216 nearest). Agrees with E11 on 98.9% of test images; predicted class distribution matches training. Evaluated only through Kaggle.
preprocessing_why: Members see the image at different resolutions, so their errors are partly independent.
name: Erdem SANVER
